temperature_cues.source: Brochure page 2; contextual identification only, not recall criteria or current replacement selection.
limits: Do not infer manufacture date from a temperature rating.
Blue bulb fluid is ambiguous between 250 and 286 F in this brochure.
Frame/deflector coating and bulb liquid are different cues.
Confirm markings and candidate-specific literature; photograph color alone does not determine temperature or recall.

component_figure_map.B: Concealed sprinkler and ceiling cover plate
component_figure_map.D: Attic sprinkler with solder link and special deflector
component_figure_map.limits: Introductory Figure F is not seal-cap Style F on page 9. Do not equate letter labels across these figures.

dry_construction_cue.cue: The guide illustrates a weep hole in the cap and a separate dry barrel/inlet.
dry_construction_cue.limits: This cue is candidate-specific; do not universalize it or use an indistinct dark spot as proof. Do not probe or manipulate a sprinkler to find a hole. Not a visible rubber O-ring.
